name: purchase_performance
summary: Evidence-based scorecards, KPI periods, composite grading and corrective-action closure
description: Supplier performance management for the Procurement module. Defines measurement periods that document each KPI's denominator, exclusions and partial-delivery treatment so results are comparable across suppliers, and computes evidence-based metrics (on-time, fill rate, acceptance, defect rate and corrective-action closure) server-side from the purchase-order, delivery-schedule and receipt transactional records. Builds weighted composite scorecards across quality, delivery, cost, service and compliance dimensions with configurable per-category weights and grade bands. A low composite raises a review or escalation for a human to authorize - it never automatically blocks a supplier. Corrective actions track root cause, plan, owner, due date and closure with independent verification (the verifier is not the responsible owner). Roll-up links to the supplier risk assessment. Physical stock and payables remain owned by Inventory and Accounting; this module only reads transactional evidence.
author: Nexa
